subject.title: fix(msteams): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text

question: After contributor-supplied live Teams proof exists, should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95867 be the canonical landing branch?
rationale: Both branches implement the same hook and neither currently has the required real Teams proof, so selecting one now would be a maintainer ownership choice rather than a correctness conclusion.

options.title: Use this PR
options.body: Prefer this branch after live proof because it exercises the shared delivery pipeline and trace-only suppression without exporting the adapter solely for testing.

options.title: Use the smaller branch
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95867 after equivalent live proof if maintainers value its smaller two-file diff and adapter-level test.

options.title: Replace both branches
options.body: Open a maintainer-owned narrow replacement if neither branch can provide acceptable real Teams proof or cleanly absorb the preferred tests.

recommendation.title: Use this PR
recommendation.body: Prefer this branch after live proof because it exercises the shared delivery pipeline and trace-only suppression without exporting the adapter solely for testing.

likelyOwner.reason: He established the accepted sibling sanitizer landing pattern and has the strongest relevant Teams refactor history.
